factual_claims.claim: AB KN Energies delivered strong financial performance for the nine months ended 30 September 2025, with consolidated revenue rising to EUR 76,664 thousand from EUR 67,977 thousand, a growth of approximately 13%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income: GROUP Revenue from contracts with customers for 1-9 months 2025 is EUR 76,664 thousand vs EUR 67,977 thousand for 2024. Growth calculation: (76,664 - 67,977)/67,977 ≈ 12.7% ≈ 13%.

factual_claims.claim: Expansion was driven principally by the Liquefied Natural Gas Terminal segment, where regasification services revenue surged to EUR 43,640 thousand from EUR 31,401 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13: Income from LNGT regasification services collected directly from LNGT users for GROUP in 9 months of 2025 is EUR 43,640 thousand vs EUR 31,401 thousand in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: This increase stems from higher regasification volumes, client bonuses for booked capacity, and the return to normal operations following the prior-year dry-dock maintenance that caused a month and a half of downtime.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13 (1): Revenue from LNG services during 9 months of 2025 is higher due to (i) terminal being out of operation for 1.5 months in 2024 due to dry-dock, (ii) higher LNG regasification volumes, and (iii) bonuses paid by LNGT clients for booked capacity.

factual_claims.claim: Revenue from liquid energy products transshipment grew moderately to EUR 21,375 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13: Sales of liquid energy products transshipment services for GROUP in 9 months of 2025 is EUR 21,375 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: Segment profitability reflected these trends, with the Liquefied Natural Gas Terminal contributing EUR 7,779 thousand to pre-tax profit and the Liquid Energy Terminals segment yielding EUR 5,293 thousand, while commercial LNG activities added EUR 9,240 thousand in revenue.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 4: GROUP segment profit before income tax for LNGT is EUR 7,779 thousand, for LET is EUR 5,293 thousand. Note 4: comLNG revenue is EUR 9,240 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: Cost of sales increased to EUR 45,115 thousand from EUR 38,740 thousand, accelerating faster than revenue due to structural accounting changes.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 14: GROUP Cost of sales for 9 months of 2025 is EUR (45,115) thousand vs EUR (38,740) thousand for 2024. Revenue growth ~13%, cost growth ~16.6%.

factual_claims.claim: Following the acquisition of the Floating Storage and Regasification Unit, depreciation expenses associated with this asset were reclassified to property, plant and equipment, embedding EUR 11,369 thousand of depreciation into cost of sales, compared to minimal amounts previously.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 14: Following acquisition of FSRU on 6 December 2024, EUR 11,369 thousand of depreciation expenses were recognized under 'Depreciation and amortisation' in 9 months of 2025 (previously under 'Depreciation of right-of-use assets').

factual_claims.claim: Furthermore, environmental taxes and emission allowances nearly doubled.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 14: Tax on environmental pollution and Emission allowances for GROUP 9 months of 2025 is EUR (3,892) thousand vs EUR (2,009) thousand in 2024. Ratio: 3,892/2,009 ≈ 1.94x (nearly double).

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses held steady at EUR 10,640 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 15: GROUP Operating expenses for 9 months of 2025 is EUR (10,640) thousand.

factual_claims.claim: Consequently, gross profit rose to EUR 31,549 thousand, supporting a robust operating profit of EUR 21,282 thousand, up from EUR 18,942 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income: GROUP Gross profit for 9 months of 2025 is EUR 31,549 thousand, Operating profit is EUR 21,282 thousand vs EUR 18,942 thousand in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Financial results were further supported by a dramatic decline in derivative-related losses, which fell to EUR 16 thousand from EUR 1,260 thousand in the comparable period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 16: Loss from financial derivatives for GROUP in 9 months of 2025 is EUR (16) thousand vs EUR (1,260) thousand in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Although interest expenses grew to EUR 6,086 thousand from EUR 4,181 thousand, partially reflecting higher borrowing costs against a slightly reduced loan principal, overall finance costs remained manageable near the previous level.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 16: Interest expenses for GROUP in 9 months of 2025 is EUR (6,086) thousand vs EUR (4,181) thousand in 2024. Note 9 shows total loan balance decreased from EUR 320,352 thousand to EUR 311,443 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: Net profit attributable to shareholders reached EUR 13,158 thousand, a 11% increase over the EUR 11,862 thousand recorded in the prior nine months.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income: GROUP Profit for the year (net profit) for 9 months of 2025 is EUR 13,158 thousand vs EUR 11,862 thousand in 2024. Increase: (13,158 - 11,862)/11,862 ≈ 10.9% ≈ 11%.

factual_claims.claim: Earnings per share improved to EUR 0.035, and total comprehensive income totaled EUR 13,215 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 17: Basic earnings per share for GROUP 9 months of 2025 is EUR 0.035. Statement of Comprehensive Income: Total comprehensive income for GROUP 9 months of 2025 is EUR 13,215 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: Liquidity and cash generation strengthened markedly.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Inferable from S16 and S17 which show significant increases in operating cash flows and cash balances.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flows more than doubled to EUR 76,331 thousand from EUR 35,637 thousand, underpinned by core operational cash generation, working capital improvements, and the reclassification of EUR 31,900 thousand in short-term deposits back to cash equivalents.
